in_marathi.name: Muru
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muru is a Sanskrit word derived from the root mur, meaning 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Muru is an epithet of Lord Shiva, representing his infinite and immovable nature.
